title: SaveTether app definition
description: Where one app keeps its saves, on each way it can be installed. Files are JSON with comments and trailing commas, named <app id>.jsonc. This schema is for editors; SaveTether's own loader is what decides, and it also checks things a schema cannot (unique ids, install ids named under "path").

id.description: Stable app id. It becomes the first part of mapping ids and the folder under savetether/.

name.description: The app's name as people know it.

installs.description: The ways this app can exist on a device. Detection picks one.

roles.description: The folders of this app that can be shared.

quirks.description: Things the owner should know about this app. Shown, not acted on.

tier.description: Who vouches for this definition. Default "verified": written and tried by hand. "imported" is converted from another source and not tried.

origin.description: Where an imported definition came from, for example "ludusavi".

store_ids.description: The app's IDs in stores, for search.

cloud_saves.description: The stores whose copies of this game keep saves in the cloud. Shown, not acted on.

tested_on.description: Where this definition was tried, for example "Steam Deck, Flatpak".

relativePath.description: A path with '/' between parts, relative to the install's base.

os.description: One system, or a list of them.

detect.description: How this install is recognised. Exactly one field.

base.description: The folder role paths are relative to: a path with tokens, or a Windows path inside a Wine prefix.

prefix.description: Which Wine prefix, on Linux. Exactly one field. Leave it out to use the prefix set for the device (--wine-prefix).

default.description: Whether this role is on when the app is added.

path.description: The folder, relative to the install's base: one path for every install, or a path per install id.

target.description: One folder name under savetether/<app id>/.

entry_depth.description: How many folder levels down one game's saves sit. Default 1.

ignore.description: Files a sync-tool integration may exclude. Unused by the core.
